#rutgers #rutgersnewark #njit #collegelife #collegefood

#drexel #penn #pennstate #collegelife #collegefood

thread:
Rutgers has the most restaurants within a 10-minute walk of campus of any big New Jersey university. Rutgers-Newark is 30 behind.

Every New Jersey university with 10,000+ students:

1. Rutgers: 182
2. Rutgers-Newark: 152
3. NJIT: 104
4. Rowan: 32
5. Kean: 18
6. Montclair State: 8

Places to eat within half a mile of each campus's center, using Overture Maps listings.

Look up any campus, with the closest places first: https://www.savorscout.net/campus/nj

Columbia has the most places to eat on its busiest food street of any Ivy League school. Harvard is 51 behind.

All 8 Ivy League schools:

1. Columbia: 144
2. Harvard: 93
3. Princeton: 56
4. Penn: 51
5. Yale: 41
6. Brown: 34
7. Cornell: 30
8. Dartmouth: 19

Places to eat on each campus's busiest street, within a mile of its center, using Overture Maps listings.
